answer.summary: The change makes ObjectReaderImplList for java.util.Arrays$ArrayList carry instanceType == CLASS_ARRAYS_LIST. This enables the dedicated Arrays.asList branch in readJSONBObject (line 429), but every other consumer of instanceType — createInstance(long) (reflective instantiation of a class with no default ctor), createInstance(Collection), and the text-mode readObject (which then calls list.add on a fixed-size list) — loses the `instanceType == ArrayList.class` fast path and likely throws. Review those methods plus the ObjectReaderBaseModule registration and the JSONB tests (DubboTest6, jsonb/basic/CollectionTest) before applying; consider adding text-mode coverage for Arrays$ArrayList.
